sourceIdentity.explanation: The worker started before the source checkpoint commit. The six compiled-source SHA256 entries in integration-checks.json and exact WASM hash pin the dirty source composition that was committed as95da422c; no clean fa520550 build is claimed.

nodeChecks.command: ESP32SIM_C5_WASM=<pinned WASM> ESP32SIM_C5_ROM=<pinned ROM> ESP32SIM_C5_FACTORY=<pinned factory> node --test tools/platform-config-test.mjs tools/platform-runtime-test.mjs tools/platform-input-test.mjs tools/platform-view-test.mjs tools/platform-c5-rom-test.mjs tools/platform-c5-wasm-test.mjs tools/platform-c5-lcd273-diagnostics-parser-test.mjs
nodeChecks.scope: Seven files: real compiled C5 cold-load ABI/corruption checks, loader/namespace protocols, diagnostics parsing and platform config/runtime/input/view checks. The ABI test does not execute firmware; the worker run below does.

check.command: node tools/c5-lcd273-acceptance.mjs --run --runtime-root <runtime checkout> --wasm <pinned WASM> --wasm-sha256 85c451d202bbad9df5ee438d95cc87107960e40bf58a6d53c0277065b0fdfd32 --rom <pinned ROM> --factory <pinned factory> --sd <pinned64MiB card> --out <new ignored output> --wall-timeout-ms 120000 --save-uart --save-sd

actions: Configure the exact LCD273 product using the documented public API.
Select Local file, open the actual file chooser and upload the unchanged factory BIN.
Observe complete merged-image recognition, then click Load and run.
Observe real guest PSRAM/app_main/SHT ID markers and exact MAC stop PC.

limits: nativeCommandCalls counts inner SdCard::command calls including failures, excluding SPI wrapper-handled commands; not all wire CMDs.
storageBlocksLoaded counts backing-store loads before reply completion and valid MISO delivery; guest-consumed reads are unobserved.
storageBlocksWritten counts complete backing-store writes; guest response consumption, FAT mount and file flush are unobserved.
CardState and presence do not establish FAT mounting or browser persistence; electrical timing and physical panel response are unverified.
SD counters belong to the card object: CMD0 and power_cycle retain totals; a new attached card starts a new epoch.
Stats and diagnostics are last publications, not live final CPU counters. Volatile pacing/speed figures are omitted; no performance claim.
The ready3D model is visual presentation, not firmware output. The original has no visible LCD frame and SD nativeCommandCalls0.
Browser IndexedDB Flash is pristine, but no guest SD write/mount/reload-persistence scenario was reached.
Exact chooser/modal action and original close banners are executor tool observations; retained pre/post snapshots and current absence corroborate the outcome. The empty chooser YAML is not evidence.

cleanupProvenance.originalCloseAndServerOutput: Observed in original tool transcript only; no dedicated raw file retained. The retained postcheck proves later absence, not original close stdout.

retainedUiStates.scope: Empty chooser snapshot; not relied on as proof of the chooser
Selected file and complete merged-image recognition

consoleCapture.scope: One DOM verbose entry, no logged JS error/warning. Separate CLI console summary was observed in tool output.

curation.kept: Exact input/source/artifact hashes, commands, measured marker/counter facts, preserved card bytes and failure/cleanup outcome.
curation.omitted: Raw captures, UART/register streams, full browser state and image remain in ignored outputs. No local server/session/PID/user identity is committed.
curation.effect: Omitting volatile browser pacing data does not change any boot, hardware or storage conclusion.

independentCheckpointReview.scope: Round002 startup/runtime evidence checkpoint only; no overall device, release or publication acceptance.
independentCheckpointReview.validation: Independent source/metadata/raw-capture/header review; no compiler reconstruction, new guest/browser or benchmark.
